display_long_description:
Prison Escape Simulator VR: Breakout puts you inside a high-security prison where freedom is earned, not given. Plan your escape, adapt to changing situations, and use every tool available to break out.
Explore detailed prison environments, interact with objects using realistic VR mechanics, and choose your own path to freedom. Sneak through guarded corridors, solve escape puzzles, distract guards, and decide whether to use stealth or force. Every action matters, and every mistake has consequences.
This immersive VR simulator gives you full control over how you escape. Observe guard patterns, collect items, craft tools, and time your moves carefully. No two escapes are the same, and multiple strategies are always possible.
Key Features
Immersive first-person VR prison experience


Multiple escape approaches: stealth, strategy, or action


Interactive environments and realistic object handling


Challenging puzzles and dynamic guard behavior


Designed for smooth and comfortable VR gameplay


Whether you prefer careful planning or bold action, Prison Escape Simulator VR: Breakout delivers a tense and rewarding escape experience built from the ground up for virtual reality.
Can you outsmart the system and make it out?
